<!--
NEVER paste report content into an issue: no addresses, phone numbers, loyalty
numbers, product names or dates drawn from a real response. Describe the shape
of the problem instead. `make check-pii` cannot see this text.
-->

## What

One or two sentences. What is wrong, or what should exist.

## Evidence

The measurement, output, or file:line that shows it. An issue filed without this
tends to get re-litigated from scratch later, because the next reader cannot tell
what was verified and what was assumed.

## Why now, or why not yet

If this is deferred, say what justified deferring it. If something already
mitigates it, say so — a gap and a live hole want different urgency.

## Approach

What you would do, and what you considered and rejected. Rejected options are
worth more than they look: they stop the next person spending a day on the thing
that was already ruled out.

## Tasks

- [ ] ...
